Name: Health and Stamina Regeneration
Author: Jessebot
TagLine: Self explanatory. Additionally, it's highly configurable. You can even make it become a simple hunger mod with just a little tweaking AND much more!
Description:
Just a little gameplay mechanic improvement.

_**Features**_

*   Health and stamina regenerates overtime

*   If you take damage/lose health, health regeneration goes on cooldown

*   If you use stamina, stamina regeneration goes on cooldown

*   Highly Configurable (See https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewMods/tree/master/HealthStaminaRegen#configure[Configuration documentation](https://github.com/JessebotX/StardewMods/tree/master/HealthStaminaRegen#configure)   )
_**Install**_

1.  Install [SMAPI (2.11 or higher)](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)

2.  Extract/Unzip zipped file into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
See [Player's Guide to Downloading Mods](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide)  if you are new to using mods or need help/

**_Compatibility_**
See [if mod is up to date and compatible here](https://mods.smapi.io/#Health_and_Stamina_Regeneration)

*   Works in Singleplayer and Multiplayer (Only works for the person who has is installed it)

*   No known mod conflicts (Report mod conflicts on the bugs/posts tab if you find any)
